final_rationale: The verdict changes because the Actor narrowed the claim from an overbroad certification position to a policy-bounded caveated certification position; no new admissible evidence was added. On the available record, clean no-caveat certification remains unsupported under the quoted policy because a material weakness may remain and the mitigation runbook is still incomplete. However, the narrower position is supportable as compliant_with_caveats: aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents were reported, and the known limitation is being treated as a disclosed limitation rather than as a resolved issue. That distinction matters. Disclosure and monitoring can support a caveated launch position, but they do not satisfy the policy predicate for no-caveat certification absent approved mitigation details or approved risk acceptance.
remaining_concerns: The remaining loan-modification hardship-document checklisting weakness still appears unresolved on the present record and therefore requires explicit disclosure for the named launch use case.
The draft monitoring runbook still lacks the policy-required mitigation fields: accountable owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
No approved mitigation artifact or approved risk-acceptance artifact is present in the admissible record summary.
Because evidence access is limited to the actor summary, the materiality assessment for the remaining weakness cannot be independently verified.
